title: Unconditional Quantum PAC Learning Advantage in the Large Error Regime
summary: We establish an unconditional super-polynomial separation between quantum and classical PAC learning of Boolean functions under the uniform distribution in the large error regime. For every advantage $λ(n) = n^{-ω(1)}$, we construct a concept class that a polynomial-time quantum learner learns to agreement $1/2+λ(n)$ with success probability at least $1-1/n^k$. The learner uses only quantum random examples and outputs a polynomial-size deterministic classical circuit.
